extDescription.message: Hear any tab in your language, spoken and subtitled in real time. Your own Gemini API key — no server in between.

panelStepKey.message: Interpretab talks to Gemini with your own API key. Get a free one at aistudio.google.com/apikey, then paste it into Options.
panelStepKey.description: First of the ordered next-step banners: shown until a key is saved. <a1> is AI Studio, <a2> opens this extension's Options page.

panelStepDirection.message: Nothing is switched on yet. Turn on Tab audio, Microphone, or both.
panelStepDirection.description: Next-step banner shown once a key is saved and neither direction is on, which is also when Start is disabled. The two bold names are the headings of the panel's two sections.

panelStepMic.message: Microphone translation needs Chrome's permission, once. Grant it in <a1>Options</a1>.
panelStepMic.description: Next-step banner shown when the microphone direction is on and Chrome has not granted the microphone. <a1> opens this extension's Options page at its Microphone section — a side panel cannot show the permission prompt itself.

panelRunningOn.message: Interpretab is running on “{1}”, and it runs on one tab at a time. Its controls are on that tab — Stop works from here.
panelRunningOn.description: {1} is the title of the tab the run is on.

panelRunningElsewhere.message: Interpretab is running on another tab, and it runs on one tab at a time. Its controls are on that tab — Stop works from here.
panelRunningElsewhere.description: The same as panelRunningOn, for when the tab's title could not be read.

panelTabDirection.message: Tab audio — this tab, into your language

panelInto.description: Reads as a sentence with the language dropdown after it: 'into [Japanese]'.

panelSourceDetected.description: Follows the target language dropdown. The language being translated from is not chosen by the user.

panelDuckLevel.description: Slider: how loud the tab's own sound stays under the translated voice.

panelMicNoteMuted.message: The interpreted voice is muted. Click the unmute button to play it through your speakers.
panelMicNoteMuted.description: Prefixes panelMicNoteSimul while the sound button is off.

panelMicNoteSimul.message: Note: wear headphones when you play it. This mode answers while you are still speaking, so it cannot mute the microphone while it talks, and a speaker feeds the translation straight back in — which degrades the translation itself.

panelMicNoteConversation.message: For two people sharing this microphone: whichever of the two languages it hears, it speaks the other. Out loud, through your speakers, which is the point — but it means the interpreter can hear itself, so keep the microphone away from them. This mode waits for each turn to finish, so it is a little slower than Simultaneous, and it is the only one the glossary applies to.

panelCostNote.message: Both directions run two concurrent Live sessions, so the API usage is roughly double.

panelUsagePaid.message: {1} so far, {2} of Gemini usage this run — an estimate, not your actual bill.
panelUsagePaid.description: {1} is how long the run has been going, {2} a rough cost. The closing disclaimer is not optional: a figure in dollars reads as a bill without it.

panelUsageFree.message: {1} so far, {2} of Gemini audio. The free tier is charged nothing for it.
panelUsageFree.description: {1} is how long the run has been going, {2} the audio it has moved. Must contain no price: the free tier is charged nothing.

panelUsageTip.message: Started {1} ago. In that time it has sent {2} of audio and been sent {3} back, both charged at 25 tokens a second.
panelUsageTip.description: Tooltip on the usage line. {1} elapsed, {2} audio sent, {3} audio received.

panelUsageTipPaid.message: Those tokens are priced at Google's published rates for the model, read from the pricing page in August 2026 rather than from your account, and rates change. Your Google account is the only place your real bill exists.

panelUsageTipFree.message: Your key is set to the free tier on the Options page, where Google charges nothing for any of it — so there is no cost to show. Set the plan to Paid there if the project has a billing account linked, and this line estimates what the run has cost.

durationSeconds.description: A duration under a minute. {1} is a whole number of seconds.

durationMinutes.description: A duration of a minute or more, rounded. {1} is a whole number of minutes.

panelMuteOffElsewhere.message: The run is on another tab.
panelMuteOffElsewhere.description: Why a mute button is greyed out.

panelLangPopular.description: Heading for the first group of a language dropdown.

panelDirTab.description: Names the tab-audio direction inside panelHeard and panelTranslated.

panelHeard.description: Tag on a transcript line carrying what was said. {1} is panelDirTab or panelDirMic.

panelTranslated.description: Tag on a transcript line carrying the translation. {1} is panelDirTab or panelDirMic.

panelCaptionsUnavailable.message: Subtitles can't be shown on this page.

optKeyNote.message: Interpretab has no server. Your audio goes straight from this browser to the Gemini Live API, authenticated with your own key — get a free one at aistudio.google.com/apikey. The key is stored in this browser's extension storage and is sent nowhere except generativelanguage.googleapis.com. Usage is billed to the Google account the key belongs to, so treat it like a password: don't share it, and don't paste it anywhere else. If it ever gets out, delete it on the same page you made it on and paste a new one in here.
optKeyNote.description: Both links go to AI Studio's key page.

optKeyPlaceholder.description: Deliberately names no key format: Google has issued two, and a hint for one tells holders of the other to look for something they do not have.

optKeyNone.message: No key yet. Interpretab cannot start without one.

optKeyStray.message: Saved, but that looks like a stray paste rather than a key.

optKeyShort.message: Saved, but that looks too short — is some of the key missing?

optPlanNote.message: Which plan the key's project is on. Interpretab has no way to tell — no Gemini API response says — and it has to know, because the side panel's meter would otherwise show a price to people Google charges nothing. On Free the meter counts time and audio; on Paid it also estimates what the run has cost. Pick the one your key is on: it is the project you made it in at aistudio.google.com/apikey, and a project is on the paid tier once it has a billing account linked.

optPlanFree.message: Free — Google charges nothing for this key

optPlanPaid.message: Paid — pay as you go, billed to your account

optVoiceNote.message: The prebuilt voice the translation is spoken in. Fixed for the life of a session, so a change applies the next time you press Start.

optVoiceOption.description: One entry in the voice dropdown. {1} is Google's name for the voice, which is not translated; {2} is one of the voice* words below.

optSizeNote.message: How tall the on-page subtitles are, in pixels. Applies immediately, even to a translation already running — drag it while watching the video and stop where it reads well.

optSizePreview.message: The quick brown fox — 素早い茶色の狐
optSizePreview.description: Sample text under the size slider. Should show both a Latin and a CJK line if the language has one, since the two set at different heights.

optMicNote.message: Chrome grants the microphone to the extension as a whole. The engine runs in a background document that cannot show a permission prompt, so if the microphone direction fails, grant it once from here.

optMicNotGranted.description: {1} is a Permissions API state, e.g. 'prompt' or 'denied'.

optInputNote.message: Which microphone the microphone direction listens to. Left on the system default, Chrome picks whatever your computer currently calls the input — which may be a headset you have unplugged, a monitor, or some other device you never speak into. That failure is silent: the session connects, the panel goes green, and nothing is ever transcribed. Name the device here if that happens. Applies the next time you press Start.

optInputSystem.message: System default — whichever microphone your computer is using

optInputAnonymous.description: A device whose name Chrome withholds until the microphone is granted. {1} is the start of its id.

optInputMissing.message: That microphone is not connected, so the system default will be used.

optInputSaved.message: Saved. Applies the next time you press Start.

optInputCleared.message: Saved. The system default microphone will be used.

optOutputNote.message: Where the microphone direction's translated voice is played. The tab direction's translation always stays on the system output — that is the one you are listening to. Applies the next time you press Start.

optOutputSystem.message: System default — the speakers you are using

optOutputMissing.message: That device is not connected, so the speakers will be used instead.

optOutputSaved.message: Saved. Applies on next Start — and whatever listens to that device has to be told to.

optOutputCleared.message: Saved. The translated voice will play on the speakers.

optDeviceNamesHidden.message: Grant the microphone above to see device names.

optDeviceSavedMissing.message: Saved device — not connected right now

optGlossaryNote.message: source,pronunciation,transcript per line. The second column is what the model is told to say; the optional third is what the captions show instead. Applies to the microphone in Two-way conversation mode only: everything else — tab audio, and the microphone's Simultaneous mode — runs the simultaneous-translation model, which takes no system instruction and so has nowhere to put a glossary.
optGlossaryNote.description: The <code> content is a CSV header and must not be translated.

optGlossaryReplaced.message: Replaced with {1} entries. Applies on next Start.

errNoKey.message: No Gemini API key yet. Open Options and paste one from aistudio.google.com/apikey.

errPreflightNoKey.message: No Gemini API key. Add one in Options.

errKeyRejected.message: Gemini rejected that API key. Check it on the Options page, or make a new one at aistudio.google.com/apikey.

errQuota.message: That API key is out of quota. Wait for the limits to reset, or set up billing to move to Tier 1 — the free tier is the one this reaches first.

errKeyForbidden.message: That API key is not allowed to call the Gemini API. Check the key's restrictions and that the Generative Language API is enabled on its project.

errAlreadyRunningOn.message: Interpretab is already running on “{1}”, and it runs on one tab at a time. Press Stop first — the Stop button works from any tab.
errAlreadyRunningOn.description: {1} is the title of the tab the run is on.

errAlreadyRunningElsewhere.message: Interpretab is already running on another tab, and it runs on one tab at a time. Press Stop first — the Stop button works from any tab.

errNoDirection.message: Enable at least one direction first.

errClickIcon.message: Click the Interpretab toolbar icon on the tab you want to translate, then press Start again. ({1})
errClickIcon.description: {1} is Chrome's own error text, which is not translated.

errMicRefused.message: Microphone access was refused. Open the extension's Options page and grant the microphone once, then try again.

captionsChromePage.message: Chrome's own pages can't take them. Open a website and click the toolbar icon there.

captionsClickIcon.message: Click the toolbar icon on that page.

captionsOpenSite.message: Open a website and click the toolbar icon there.

micNoSoundNamed.message: No sound has reached the microphone since Start. It is recording from “{1}” — if that is not what you are speaking into, name the right one under Audio input in Options and press Start again.
micNoSoundNamed.description: {1} is the device label the operating system reports.

micNoSoundDefault.message: No sound has reached the microphone since Start. It is recording from your system's default input — if that is not what you are speaking into, name the right one under Audio input in Options and press Start again.

micDeviceMissing.message: The microphone chosen in Options is not available ({1}), so your system's default input is being used instead.

outputDeviceMissing.message: The audio output chosen in Options is not available ({1}), so your translated voice is coming out of the speakers instead. Pick another one in Options.

closeReasonGiven.description: {1} is the server's own reason, which arrives in English and is not translated.

closeReasonOpaqueHint.message: Could not reach the Gemini Live API — a browser is not told why. {1}

closeReasonOpaque.message: Could not reach the Gemini Live API — a browser is not told why. Usually the API key: missing, rejected, or out of quota, which the free tier runs into first.

closeBeforeReady.message: The session was closed before it was ready.

hintKeyAccepted.message: The key itself was accepted by the API a moment ago, so this is the Live API or the network rather than the key.

loopGaveUp.message: {1} Interpretab stopped trying after {2} attempts in a row. Check your API key on the Options page, and your quota in Google AI Studio — the free tier's limits on the Live models are low. Press Start to try again.
loopGaveUp.description: {1} is whichever failure message came last; {2} is a number of attempts.

loopDropping.message: The connection to Gemini keeps dropping.

glossaryMissingField.message: Line {1} is missing source or target.
